title: SQL lab: select, filter, and deterministic ordering

turns.message: Give me a challenge on this.
I'll guess: LIMIT 3 alone chooses the three most expensive products.
I’m stuck; what makes a tie in price deterministic?
Give me another challenge on this.
Correct answer: sort by price DESC and then product_id ASC before applying LIMIT 3.
/verify ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC makes the top-three result deterministic when prices tie.

expectations.notes: Use the seeded shop schema and preserve requested columns; explain that LIMIT operates after ORDER BY and row order is otherwise undefined; check boundary and date predicates without changing the schema.
